newsitem.title: FINLAND: SENTRA SAYS OWNERS APPROVE TUKO DEAL.
newsitem.headline: SENTRA SAYS OWNERS APPROVE TUKO DEAL.

text.p: Finnish retailer Sentra Oy said on Wednesday that its extraordinary shareholders' meeting approved the company's acquisition of Tuko Oy units and the sale of its Carrols fast-food chain.

"Sentra's extraordinary shareholders' meeting on February 26, 1997 approved the acquisition of Suomen Spar Oy's share capital from Tuko Oy for 253 million markka and the acquisition of a 35 percent stake in TukoSpar Oy for 82 million markka," Sentra said in a statement.
"The meeting also approved the sale of Carrols business operations to Tuko for 90 million markka," it said.

The acquisitions would take effect on condition that the European Commission approved the deals, Sentra said, referring to the EU competition authorities' vetting of Tuko divestments by retail and wholesale group Kesko Oy .
